mood.label: RISK-OFF
mood.summary: Surging global bond yields and escalating US-Iran tensions are pushing oil prices higher and equities lower. Tech and growth stocks are under significant pressure as the 10-year Treasury yield approaches multi-year highs.

indicesNarrative: Futures indicate a sharply lower open across all major indices, with the tech-heavy Nasdaq leading losses. The sell-off is driven by a flight from risk assets as the 10-year Treasury yield hits its highest level since January 2025 and oil prices surge on geopolitical news, stoking inflation fears.
technicalsNarrative: Technical data was not available at the time of generation. Entries should be approached with extreme caution in a risk-off environment with elevated volatility.

sectorsNarrative: A clear rotation out of growth and cyclical sectors into energy is evident. Technology, a leader yesterday, is poised to give back gains as rising rates pressure valuations.
industryNarrative: Semiconductor stocks are showing significant pre-market weakness after a mixed session yesterday, pressured by rising yields and some profit-taking. Oil and gas exploration and production companies are the standout strength, directly benefiting from the surge in crude prices.
